$comment: This site's asset registry. The design system owns the central asset manifest
for its own assets; this file registers only the application-owned assets that
must pass the same governance: a favicon the framework requires as a file, and
one theme-aware SVG component that cannot be authored as a file asset without
losing the cascade. Every other application asset arrives as it is added, as an
entry here, and fails ASSET004 until it does.

assets.exception: Next.js requires the favicon as a file at app/icon.svg. The mark is the product's own drawing; it carries a fixed colour because it renders outside the token cascade, on a favicon and in a document viewer.

A React SVG component rather than a file asset, because its recipe is theme-aware token fills (currentColor plus emitted utilities) and the ambient travel animation, neither of which survives authoring as a static file consumed through an img element. It is sanitized by the same gate that guards file SVGs: no script, no handler attributes, no dangerous inner markup.
